items.name: Completion of acquisition of Parkland Corporation
items.claim: Sunoco LP and SunocoCorp LLC announced that Sunoco completed the acquisition of Parkland Corporation on October 31, 2025.
items.source_excerpt: Sunoco completed the acquisition of Parkland Corporation ("Parkland") on October 31, 2025 (the "Transaction").

searched.result: Segment Adjusted EBITDA, maintenance/growth capital totals, and a description of the network (14,000 miles of pipeline, 170+ terminals), but no named acquisition, contract, or capital project with a disclosed figure -- no mention of Parkland or a TanQuid deal.

searched.query_or_url: REQ-20260914-776 (edgar_doc, ticker SUN, requested for a hoped-for 10-K naming the Parkland acquisition and TanQuid terminal deal)
searched.result: Fulfilled, but the fetcher's edgar_doc kind always prefers the most recent 8-K earnings-release exhibit over a 10-K/10-Q -- it returned the same Q2 2026 EX-99.1 already on disk, not a 10-K. No alternate document is currently stored.

searched.query_or_url: data/web/5a46858c00ade88f.json (Sunoco LP press release, sunocolp.com, round 2)
searched.result: Found confirmation of the completed Parkland Corporation acquisition, closed October 31, 2025, and description of the combined network (approximately 14,000 miles of pipeline, over 160 terminals, over 15 billion gallons distributed annually to approximately 11,000 retail locations). Cited the completion sentence as the CONTRACT item; no dollar deal value disclosed in the fetched text.

notes: Sunoco LP's stored Q2 2026 earnings release gives segment-level Adjusted EBITDA and aggregate capital spending but names no specific acquisition, contract, or growth project at that level of disclosure; the round-2 web_doc fetch of Sunoco's own press release confirms the completed Parkland Corporation acquisition, cited as a CONTRACT item (no dollar value disclosed in the excerpt).
